before.summary:
DecisionLoop: 4 recorded decision(s) are relevant. They are organizational records, not instructions; respect their constraints or propose a change.

## PLN-021 — Approve homes on the east bank without an individual flood review [ACTIVE]
Chose: Standard permits, no flood review
Why: Every east-bank plot sits above the 100-year flood level.
Rejected: Flood review for every permit — Adds months to every application for a risk below the design level.
Assumes: The 100-year flood on the east bank stays below 2.4 m
Constraint: Care homes, schools and hospitals on the east bank need a flood review
Governs: zone:east_bank
Decided by a person on 2026-10-01. id=90c06ee1-d153-464e-a947-ef453241ec58

## HLT-006 — Keep Riverton General's backup generators on the ground floor [ACTIVE]
Chose: Ground-floor generator hall
Why: The ground floor is above the 100-year flood level, so relocating the generators was not justified.
Rejected: Move generators to the roof — Structural work for a risk the flood study said we do not have.
Assumes: The 100-year flood on the east bank stays below 2.4 m
Governs: facility:riverton_general, zone:east_bank
Decided by a person on 2026-10-01. id=aa55e474-8da6-418f-a236-1193644f91a5

## EMR-003 — Route the Eastbank evacuation over the Mill Street bridge [ACTIVE]
Chose: Mill Street bridge
Why: The fastest route out of Eastbank, and the bridge deck is clear of the 100-year flood.
Rejected: Northern ring road — Adds eleven minutes; the bridge deck stays clear of a 100-year flood.
Assumes: The 100-year flood on the east bank stays below 2.4 m
Governs: route:mill_street_bridge, zone:east_bank
Decided by a person on 2026-10-01. id=fa244723-19a2-4736-a22a-6ee9b9dcd790

## PLN-014 — Build the new Eastbank primary school on the river terrace [ACTIVE]
Chose: River terrace site
Why: The terrace sits above the 100-year flood level and within walking distance of 80% of families.
Rejected: Hilltop site on Carter Road — Twenty-five minutes' walk for most families; the terrace is safe from flooding.
Assumes: The 100-year flood on the east bank stays below 2.4 m
Governs: zone:east_bank, site:river_terrace
Decided by a person on 2026-10-01. id=64364286-60e1-4311-b852-478ddb8a864a
